question: The ecosystem feed indexed @socketfi/server in July 2026. What kind of project is SocketFi according to Scout, and which Soroban hook do official docs say its passkey-style contract account must implement?

golden.answer: As observed on 2026-07-11, Lumenloop's indexed @socketfi/server item describes a backend SDK that verifies SocketFi authentication tokens and prepares simulated/assembled Soroban transactions for paymaster signing. Scout lists SocketFi as a live, SCF-funded, non-custodial Soroban smart-wallet dApp using passkey sign-in with social-profile binding and gas abstraction. Official Stellar docs say a contract account implements `__check_auth`: `require_auth` for that contract address invokes this hook with the signed payload, signatures, and authorization context, and the hook accepts or rejects authentication and policy checks.
keyFacts: Reports indexed @socketfi/server as a token-verifying backend SDK.
Reports Soroban transaction preparation for paymaster signing.
Uses Scout for SocketFi: live, SCF-funded, non-custodial Soroban smart wallet, passkeys.
Explains `require_auth` invokes the hook for authentication and authorization checks.
avoid: Do NOT describe SocketFi as a classic G-address wallet whose passkeys are checked by SEP-10.
Do NOT claim the npm package itself is the on-chain account contract.
golden.notes: Both the current project/package evidence and the official contract-account mechanism are mandatory.

sources.ref: http://localhost:8787/mcp — Lumenloop and Scout live probes, observed 2026-07-11

corroboration.claim: SocketFi is a live passkey-oriented Soroban smart-wallet project and @socketfi/server is its backend integration package.
Soroban contract accounts implement __check_auth, which is reached through require_auth.

verified.by: golden-truth scheduled re-verification, 2026-10-27 (Claude Opus 5.5; HackMeridian review CI unblock)
evidence: Live re-check 2026-10-27 (A/F): https://registry.npmjs.org/@socketfi%2Fserver — latest 1.1.0 (2026-07-05); description: server-side SDK for verifying SocketFi authentication tokens and preparing Soroban transactions.

Live re-check 2026-10-27 (C): production Raven scout.searchProjects(q=SocketFi) — status Live, scfAwarded true (SCF #32 Build, official record), non-custodial Soroban smart wallet with passkey sign-in, social-profile binding, and gas abstraction; lumenloop.find_content_about_project(slug=socketfi) still indexes @socketfi/server as a token-verifying SDK that prepares transactions for paymaster signing.
Live re-check 2026-10-27 (B): Scout repo rows show active Socket-Fi/socketfi-smart-account commits through 2026-10-21 (https://github.com/Socket-Fi/socketfi-smart-account).

Live re-check 2026-10-27 (A): https://developers.stellar.org/docs/build/guides/auth/contract-authorization — __check_auth is the reserved CustomAccountInterface hook the host invokes when require_auth/require_auth_for_args is called; it verifies credentials and policy.
